audit_type: Requirement-by-requirement research and deliverable audit; source reviews remain the substantive evidence

requirements.requirement: Ministry consultation pages, Bundestag hearings and Lobbyregister investigated
requirements.assessment: Substantive source reviews and records cover all three channels; gated author-publication leads are explicitly unresolved, not asserted as formally received submissions.

requirements.requirement: Ongoing and completed federal processes, addressed draft versions
requirements.assessment: Each issue contains addressed-version metadata. Examples include ongoing JStG2026 consultation and completed2018CannKG process. Historical official/mirror and byte-edition limits are explicit; later law is not silently used as addressed draft.

requirements.requirement: Factual or source-description mismatch; context and benign alternatives
requirements.assessment: Independently reviewed provisional cases are separated from unresolved leads. Negative screens record rescued readings, missing evidence and model disagreements without promoting them as errors.

requirements.requirement: User JSON fields, ai_screened, severity versus direction, null unknown
requirements.assessment: All79 issue records retain requested fields and ai_screened. Separate materiality/direction explanations present; unknown-direction entries are null.

requirements.requirement: Exact short original quotations, labelled translations, precise locators and request grounding
requirements.assessment: Automated extraction, actual visual reviews and declared web-only source checks are distinguished. All request evidence resolves, including shared and cross-issue references. No automated check is claimed to establish substantive truth.

requirements.requirement: Correction, effect and limits; no intent or invented response
requirements.assessment: Every record explains effect/limits and separate materiality/direction. Unresolved cases may state correction conditionally. Specialist fields remain null and author_response arrays empty.

requirements.requirement: Multiple AI agents independently check one another
requirements.assessment: All52 provisional findings have saved independent-AI reviews. The four-agent team made reciprocal primary-source checks; no human specialist review is implied.

requirements.requirement: Save project-folder deliverables; preserve first round
requirements.assessment: Saved JSON and source/review artifacts exist. Original32baselineissue quotations unchanged; original first-round timing bytes equal baseline snapshot.

requirements.requirement: Spend another at least two hours and finish started cases
requirements.assessment: Completed minimum duration: 8118 elapsed seconds and 7205 goal-reported time-used seconds; all screened round-two raw records manifested, with unresolved limits retained.

limits: Mechanical completeness does not establish factual correctness. Two formal-channel gates and other substantive uncertainties are intentionally preserved as unresolved leads. No specialist review or author contact.
